summary: Frontend visual regression test for BABL Studio Sidebar bug fix (vertical letter-by-letter card titles). Tested on 3 mobile viewports (iPhone SE 375x667, iPhone 12 390x844, Pixel 411x823). Bug FIXED: all 7 category cards render titles/subtitles horizontally on 1 line without wrapping issues. Sidebar width correctly clamped between 288-340px (measured 288px on iPhone SE/12, 296px on Pixel). Selection state (border kaki + fond crème) works. Close button works. Backdrop close works (initial false-negative in automation was due to force=True click hitting the topmost element (panel) at center coordinates; verified working via real click at coords beyond panel width). Workspace fully visible without scroll when sidebar closed (clip + gabarit + 3 perles + boucle). Workspace remains partially visible (~85-90px) on right when sidebar open. No console errors. Two deprecation warnings observed (shadow* and pointerEvents) — non-blocking.

react_native_issues.issue: React Native Web deprecation warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'. Emitted from panel shadow (Sidebar.tsx:155-158) and card shadow (index.tsx:73-76). Non-blocking but should be migrated.
React Native Web deprecation warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Reference: pointerEvents="box-none" on the overlay View.

action_items: Optional: replace shadow* props with boxShadow (or platform-specific styles) in Sidebar.tsx and app/index.tsx to silence RN Web deprecation warnings.
Optional: move pointerEvents="box-none" to style prop on the sidebar overlay View (Sidebar.tsx:77).
critical_code_review_comments: Sidebar useEffect dependency array only includes [visible] but references SIDEBAR_WIDTH (dependent on screenWidth). If user rotates device with sidebar closed, translateX resting value may not update. Minor edge case — not blocking mobile MVP.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sidebar bug fix validated across 3 mobile viewports. Panel width measurements: iPhone SE=288px, iPhone 12=288px (clamp min), Pixel=295.9px. Card widths: 248px (iPhone) / 256px (Pixel). All titles render horizontally on 1 line. Note for backdrop testing: Playwright's page.click('[data-testid="sidebar-backdrop"]', force=True) will FAIL because the backdrop has StyleSheet.absoluteFill and force=True clicks at element center (inside panel area). Use page.mouse.click(x, y) with x > SIDEBAR_WIDTH to properly test backdrop close.
rca_of_issue: Original bug: cards were too narrow (~232px on iPhone SE with previous 62% width = 232px), causing title text to wrap letter-by-letter vertically. Fix applied: SIDEBAR_WIDTH = Math.max(288, Math.min(340, screenWidth * 0.72)) guarantees ≥288px, giving each card ≥248px inner width (after 14+12+12+12+44 padding/icon/margin = 94px overhead → 194px for text). At fontSize 15, 'Silicone hexagonale' (18 chars) fits comfortably on 1 line. CategoryCard title uses numberOfLines={2} as safety net. Verified visually: no vertical text rendering on any tested viewport.
